name: Lock-strafe
author: OpenRAC contributors
description: Strafe as in the later games. Lock with weapons: with a weapon that fires ahead in hand, Ratchet always faces where the camera looks, the right stick turns him and the left stick strafes (Up Your Arsenal's lock-strafe). Hold L2 or R2: the camera swings behind him and he strafes while it is held (Going Commando's). L1 still looks and R1 still crouches.

settings.name: Mode
settings.description: Lock: always with a weapon that fires ahead, Hold otherwise. Hold: only while L2 or R2 is held.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for each pad report, with what the strafe does.
